copy.tagline: 用 Chat SDK 接入 WhatsApp 官方消息通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发需要接入 WhatsApp 消息的应用。
copy.tagline_en: Add WhatsApp Business Cloud API channel via Chat SDK
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app that needs WhatsApp messaging.

howto.what: Claude 会把 WhatsApp Cloud 适配器从 channels 分支复制进 src/channels/,注册到 channel barrel,安装固定版本的适配器包,再构建并跑注册测试,让项目接入官方 Meta WhatsApp Business Cloud API 渠道。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 接入官方 Meta WhatsApp Business Cloud API 渠道时触发;它会复制、注册并构建验证该适配器。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加上 WhatsApp Cloud API 渠道
say.note: 会复制适配器、注册并构建验证

say.text: 帮我把 WhatsApp 的四项凭据写进 .env
say.note: 会依次提示你粘贴 access token 等值

say.text: 检查 WhatsApp 渠道有没有注册成功

howto.what_en: It copies the WhatsApp Cloud adapter from the channels branch into src/channels/, registers it in the channel barrel, installs @chat-adapter/whatsapp@4.29.0, then builds and runs the registration test.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to add the official Meta WhatsApp Business Cloud API channel to NanoClaw; it copies, registers and build-verifies the adapter.

say_en.text: Add the WhatsApp Cloud API channel to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers and build-verifies it

say_en.text: Write my four WhatsApp credentials into .env
say_en.note: It prompts you to paste each value in turn

say_en.text: Check whether the WhatsApp channel registered
